messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — prelaunch sync for the marketplace edge adapter and hardware partner FW signing. Need to confirm: private listing flow, signed firmware delivery, and SI onboarding docs. Short bullets pls.
Mira Patel: +1. Is the private listing going to require a vendor-reviewed SC metadata bundle?
Samir Gupta: Yup, Snow asked for a signed manifest and a bin-signed FW hash. We should also include an attestations.json with provenance.
Alex Chen: Good, add that to the checklist. Also: ETA on firmware signing from the HW partner?
Kai (partner-eng): Partner shipping team says signing key rotation is scheduled next week (3/22). They can produce signed images by 3/24 if we provide the manifest template now.
Jen L: I can draft the manifest template. Will include fields: vendor_id, image_version, fw_hash_sha256, signing_certificate, release_notes_url, support_contact.
Samir Gupta: Throw in a minimal compatibility matrix too — supported SNOW connector versions and runtime expectations (kernel deps, max payload).
Mira Patel: For private listing, legal also needs export control flags + data residency statement. I’ll loop in legal after Jen posts draft.
Alex Chen: Cool. Two quick ops checks: 1) marketplace-cli flow for private listings — is the CLI step the same for onprem listings? 2) ingestion telemetry — do we need to send a telemetry opt-in during onboarding?
Samir Gupta: 1) CLI is same but requires --private + --vendor-contract flag. Example:
```
marketplace-cli upload --package edge-adapter --region eu-west-1 --private --vendor-contract ./contract.pdf
```
2) Telemetry must be opt-in. We'll provide a toggle in the JS installer and surface the opt-out URL in onboarding docs.
MarketBot: Reminder: marketplace listing review SLA = 5 business days once vendor bundle is submitted. (auto)
Kai (partner-eng): Noted. We should target submitting by 3/25 to hit a 4/1 go-live if review goes smooth.
Jen L: Drafted manifest template and posted to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.example/edge-manifest-template (private).
Alex Chen: Thanks Jen — Mira, Samir: can you both review tonight? If all clear we'll package and send to partner for signing tomorrow.
Mira Patel: Will review tonight. Quick note — add a field for "allowed_regions" so marketplace reviewers can flag geo restrictions early.
Samir Gupta: Adding allowed_regions and a minimal boot log sample. Also adding a snippet for checksum verification in installer:
```bash
EXPECTED=abc123...
sha256sum firmware.bin | grep $EXPECTED || echo "checksum mismatch" && exit 1
```
Jen L: Added allowed_regions and boot log example. Updated doc link.
Alex Chen: Super. One last thing: SI onboarding runbook — who owns the runbook tasks? I propose: Kai for partner coordination, Samir for install scripts, Jen for docs, Mira for legal/GTM checklist.
Kai (partner-eng): That works for me. I’ll schedule a short runbook handoff with the partner PM.
Mira Patel: I’ll draft the GTM acceptance criteria (co-marketing approvals, embargo dates, customer support SLA).
MarketBot: Teammate @Kai (partner-eng) added to channel #marketplace-onboarding.
Alex Chen: Great. If no blockers we aim to submit bundle 3/24 EOD. Flag any risks here. :eyes:
Jen L: Risk: partner's CI currently failing signing step on ARM builds. Already opened ticket with their infra team.
Samir Gupta: Mitigation: we can accept x86 signed images for initial marketplace private listing and include ARM as a follow-up patch.
Mira Patel: Legal risk: export classification pending — might delay listing by a week. I’ll escalate.
Kai (partner-eng): Partner committed to prioritizing signing but asked for our manifest by EOD today.
Alex Chen: OK — Jen, share final manifest link here when done. Samir, can you prep the CLI bundle command and verification script? Mira, please ping legal. I’ll do a quick alignment with partner PM at 10:30 PST.
Jen L: Final manifest pushed: https://drive.redwood.example/edge-manifest-final.json
Samir Gupta: CLI package command ready and uploaded to repo: https://git.redwood.example/edge-adapter/releases/tag/1.0-rc
Mira Patel: Legal pinged. Will update thread when classification clears.
Alex Chen: Thanks all. Quick status check tomorrow at 9am PT. :thumbsup:
